item.title: US Inflation Softens Ahead of Fed Data, Jackson Hole
item.description: [Bloomberg] Senior Research Economist Sree Kochugovindan from Aberdeen discussed the recent US inflation data, describing it as a subdued core inflation print that has somewhat eased pressure on the Federal Reserve. Despite inflation remaining elevated and outpacing wage growth, the inflation report was considered a bit of a nonevent. Kochugovindan emphasized that there is still more economic data to be released and the upcoming Jackson Hole symposium remains a critical event for gauging the Fed's next moves. He suggested that it is still too early to definitively extrapolate the Fed's September rate decision based solely on the latest inflation figures. (Source: Bloomberg)
